q_vocab_c1_01_001.question: ماذا does 'cabe destacar' يعني في academic writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_001.correct: it is worth noting / it should be highlighted
q_vocab_c1_01_001.explanation: 'Cabe destacar' هو a لـmal academic expression بمعنى 'هو هو worth noting' أو 'هو ينبغي يكون highlighted'. هو يُستخدم لـ draw الـ reader's attention إلى an important point في لـmal writing.

q_vocab_c1_01_002.question: ما معنى 'en lo que respecta a'؟
q_vocab_c1_01_002.correct: with regard to / as far as ... is concerned
q_vocab_c1_01_002.explanation: 'En lo que respecta a' يعني 'مع regard إلى' أو 'as far as ... هو concerned'. هو هو a لـmal linking phrase used إلى introduce a specific topic أو aspect within academic discourse.

q_vocab_c1_01_003.question: A modo de ___, podemos afirmar que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial.
q_vocab_c1_01_003.explanation: 'A modo de conclusión' يعني 'بواسطة way من conclusion'. هذا phrase يُستخدم في academic papers إلى signal الـ final summary أو closing remarks من an argument.

q_vocab_c1_01_004.question: ماذا does 'según los datos' يعني في a research context?
q_vocab_c1_01_004.explanation: 'Según los datos' يعني 'according إلى الـ data'. هو يُستخدم في academic writing إلى introduce evidence-based claims supported بواسطة empirical findings.

q_vocab_c1_01_005.question: ماذا does 'no obstante' يعني في رسمي writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_005.explanation: 'No obstante' هو a لـmal connector بمعنى 'nevertheless' أو 'ومع ذلك'. هو introduces a contrasting idea و هو considered more elevated في register than 'pero' أو 'sin embargo'.

q_vocab_c1_01_006.question: في light من الـ above
q_vocab_c1_01_006.correct: a la luz de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_01_006.explanation: 'في light من الـ above' translates إلى 'a la luz de lo anterior' في الإسبانية. هذا academic phrase refers back إلى previously stated evidence أو arguments إلى support a new point.

q_vocab_c1_01_007.question: ما معنى 'dicho de otro modo'؟
q_vocab_c1_01_007.explanation: 'Dicho de otro modo' يعني 'في other words' أو 'put differently'. هو يُستخدم في academic texts إلى rephrase أو clarify a complex idea لـ الـ reader.

q_vocab_c1_01_008.question: cabe señalar
q_vocab_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' يعني 'هو ينبغي يكون pointed out'. Like 'cabe destacar', هو uses الـ impersonal فعل 'caber' في its sense من 'إلى يكون fitting' إلى introduce noteworthy inلـmation.

q_vocab_c1_01_009.question: أنت هم writing a thesis introduction و need إلى present الـ scope من لك research. Which expression هو معظم appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_01_009.correct: El presente estudio se centra en analizar los factores que inciden en el fenómeno.
wrong: Este trabajo habla de cosas interesantes.
Voy a escribir sobre un tema que me gusta.
Aquí explico lo que pienso del asunto.
q_vocab_c1_01_009.explanation: 'El presente estudio se centra en' يعني 'الـ present study focuses on'. هذا الـ standard لـmal register expected في academic thesis introductions, using precise و impersonal لغة.

q_vocab_c1_01_010.question: أنت need إلى acknowledge a limitation في لك research methodology. Which phrasing demonstrates appropriate academic register?
q_vocab_c1_01_010.correct: Si bien este estudio presenta ciertas limitaciones metodológicas, los hallazgos resultan significativos.
wrong: El estudio tiene problemas pero no importa mucho.
Los errores del estudio no son tan graves como parecen.
Hay fallos pero los resultados son buenos de todas formas.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Si bien' (على الرغم) combined مع 'limitaciones metodológicas' (methodological limitations) و 'hallazgos significativos' (significant findings) represents الـ balanced, objective tone required في academic writing متى addressing study limitations.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.context: Writing the limitations section of a research paper

q_vocab_c1_02_001.question: ماذا does 'la patología' يعني في medical terminology?
q_vocab_c1_02_001.explanation: 'La patología' يعني 'pathology', referring إلى الـ study من diseases أو إلى a disease condition itself. في clinical settings, هو encompasses الـ causes, mechanisms, و effects من diseases.

q_vocab_c1_02_002.question: El tribunal dictó una ___ absolutoria a favor del acusado.
q_vocab_c1_02_002.explanation: 'Sentencia absolutoria' يعني 'acquittal ruling'. الـ sentence يعني 'الـ court issued an acquittal ruling في favor من الـ defendant.' في legal terminology, 'sentencia' يشير إلى a judicial ruling أو verdict.

q_vocab_c1_02_003.question: ما معنى 'el ensayo clínico'؟
q_vocab_c1_02_003.explanation: 'El ensayo clínico' يعني 'clinical trial', a research study conducted إلى evaluate الـ safety و efficacy من medical treatments, drugs, أو devices on human participants.

q_vocab_c1_02_004.question: ما معنى 'la jurisprudencia'؟
q_vocab_c1_02_004.explanation: 'La jurisprudencia' يعني 'jurisprudence' أو 'case law', الـ body من legal principles established through previous court decisions ذلك guides future judicial rulings.

q_vocab_c1_02_005.question: genome
q_vocab_c1_02_005.explanation: 'Genome' translates إلى 'el genoma' في الإسبانية. هو يشير إلى الـ complete set من genetic material present في an organism. 'El gen' هو a single gene, بينما 'la genética' هو الـ field من genetics.

q_vocab_c1_02_006.question: ماذا does 'el peritaje' يعني في a legal أو professional context?
q_vocab_c1_02_006.explanation: 'El peritaje' يعني 'expert assessment' أو 'لـensic evaluation', a technical report prepared بواسطة a qualified specialist ('perito') إلى provide evidence أو inلـmed opinion في legal أو professional matters.

q_vocab_c1_02_007.question: A research team publishes findings about a new treatment لـ autoimmune diseases. Which term describes الـ body's immune system attacking its own cells?
q_vocab_c1_02_007.correct: una enfermedad autoinmune: el sistema inmunitario ataca los tejidos propios del organismo
wrong: una alergia: el cuerpo reacciona a sustancias externas
una infección: bacterias invaden el cuerpo
una intoxicación: el cuerpo absorbe sustancias tóxicas
q_vocab_c1_02_007.explanation: 'Enfermedad autoinmune' يعني 'autoimmune disease'. الـ immune system ('sistema inmunitario') mistakenly attacks الـ body's own healthy tissues ('tejidos propios'), unlike allergies أو infections which involve external agents.

q_vocab_c1_02_008.question: ماذا does 'el protocolo' يعني في a scientific أو diplomatic context?
q_vocab_c1_02_008.explanation: 'El protocolo' يعني 'protocol', a لـmal set من rules أو established procedures governing conduct في official, scientific, أو diplomatic settings. في research, هو defines الـ methodology و steps من an experiment.

q_vocab_c1_02_009.question: la nanotecnología
q_vocab_c1_02_009.explanation: 'La nanotecnología' يعني 'nanotechnology', الـ branch من technology dealing مع الـ manipulation من matter at an atomic أو molecular scale, typically below 100 nanometers.

q_vocab_c1_02_010.question: A lawyer argues ذلك a contract clause هو unenforceable لأن one party signed under duress. Which legal concept applies?
q_vocab_c1_02_010.correct: Vicio del consentimiento: la voluntad de una de las partes fue coaccionada.
wrong: Prescripción: el contrato ha expirado por el paso del tiempo.
Novación: el contrato fue sustituido por uno nuevo.
Subrogación: una tercera parte asumió las obligaciones.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.explanation: 'Vicio del consentimiento' يعني 'defect من consent'. متى a party signs a contract under 'coacción' (duress), الـ agreement يمكن أن يكون voided لأن genuine free سوف كان absent. هذا a fundamental principle في contract law.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.context: Civil court hearing on contract validity

q_vocab_c1_03_001.question: ماذا هو الـ key difference between 'lograr' و 'conseguir'?
q_vocab_c1_03_001.correct: 'Lograr' emphasizes achieving a goal through effort; 'conseguir' means to obtain or manage to do something
wrong: They are completely identical in all contexts
'Lograr' means to lose and 'conseguir' means to win
q_vocab_c1_03_001.explanation: بينما both يمكن يعني 'إلى achieve', 'lograr' carries a stronger connotation من accomplishment بعد sustained efلـt (lograr un sueño = achieve a dream), whereas 'conseguir' هو broader, بمعنى إلى obtain أو manage إلى do something (conseguir entradas = get tickets).

q_vocab_c1_03_002.question: ما معنى 'carecer de'؟
q_vocab_c1_03_002.correct: to lack / to be devoid of
q_vocab_c1_03_002.explanation: 'Carecer de' يعني 'إلى lack' أو 'إلى يكون devoid من'. هو هو a لـmal فعل used للتعبير الـ absence من something: 'El inلـme carece de evidencia sólida' (الـ report lacks solid evidence).

q_vocab_c1_03_003.question: El candidato ___ un puesto de trabajo acorde con su experiencia profesional.
q_vocab_c1_03_003.explanation: 'Solicitar' يعني 'إلى apply لـ' أو 'إلى لـmally request', used في professional و administrative contexts. 'Pedir' هو a more general و inلـmal 'إلى ask لـ', بينما 'solicitar' implies a لـmal process such as job applications أو official requests.

q_vocab_c1_03_004.question: ماذا هو الـ nuanced difference between 'realizar' و 'hacer'?
q_vocab_c1_03_004.correct: 'Realizar' implies carrying out something planned or significant; 'hacer' is the general verb for 'to do/make'
wrong: 'Realizar' means to make real and 'hacer' means to destroy
They are exact synonyms with no difference
'Realizar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_03_004.explanation: 'Realizar' suggests executing something مع deliberation و importance (realizar una investigación = conduct a study), بينما 'hacer' هو الـ everyday, كل-purpose فعل لـ doing أو making things. Using 'realizar' elevates الـ register.

q_vocab_c1_03_005.question: ماذا does 'matizar' يعني في الـ context من argumentation?
q_vocab_c1_03_005.correct: to qualify / to nuance / to add subtle distinctions
q_vocab_c1_03_005.explanation: 'Matizar' يعني 'إلى qualify' أو 'إلى add nuance'. في academic أو professional discourse, هو يشير إلى refining a statement بواسطة adding subtle distinctions أو clarifications, e.g., 'Conviene matizar esta afirmación' (هذا statement ينبغي يكون qualified).

q_vocab_c1_03_006.question: إلى undermine / إلى weaken
q_vocab_c1_03_006.explanation: 'إلى undermine' translates إلى 'socavar' في الإسبانية. هو يعني إلى weaken أو erode something gradually, غالباً used figuratively: 'socavar la confianza' (إلى undermine trust). Do not confuse مع 'subrayar' (إلى underline).

q_vocab_c1_03_007.question: ماذا هو الـ difference between 'aludir a' و 'referirse a'?
q_vocab_c1_03_007.correct: 'Aludir a' means to allude to (indirectly); 'referirse a' means to refer to (directly)
wrong: They are identical in meaning and usage
'Aludir a' is more direct than 'referirse a'
'Aludir a' means to hallucinate about something
q_vocab_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Aludir a' implies an indirect أو subtle reference (El autor alude a la guerra sin mencionarla = الـ author alludes إلى الـ war بدون mentioning هو), بينما 'referirse a' هو a direct و explicit reference إلى something.

q_vocab_c1_03_008.question: prescindir de
q_vocab_c1_03_008.correct: to do without / to dispense with
q_vocab_c1_03_008.explanation: 'Prescindir de' يعني 'إلى do بدون' أو 'إلى dispense مع'. هو expresses deliberately choosing إلى omit أو لـgo something: 'Podemos prescindir de estos datos' (We يمكن do بدون هذا data).

q_vocab_c1_03_009.question: أنت هم editing a colleague's report و notice هم used 'detentar' إلى يعني 'إلى hold a position legitimately'. هو هذا usage صحيح?
q_vocab_c1_03_009.correct: No, 'detentar' implies holding power illegitimately; the correct word is 'ostentar' or 'ocupar'.
wrong: Yes, 'detentar' is the only correct verb for holding any position.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.explanation: 'Detentar' specifically يعني إلى hold power أو a position illegitimately أو بدون proper right, بينما 'ostentar' أو 'ocupar' تُستخدم لـ legitimate office-holding. هذا a frequently confused pair even among native speakers.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.context: Editing a professional report لـ publication

q_vocab_c1_03_010.question: A novelist wants إلى convey ذلك a character views الـ world مع excessive optimism ذلك ignores reality. Which فعل best captures هذا nuance?
q_vocab_c1_03_010.correct: 'Idealizar': atribuir cualidades de perfección a algo que no las tiene.
wrong: 'Optimizar': mejorar algo para hacerlo más eficiente.
'Visualizar': formar una imagen mental de algo.
'Imaginar': crear algo ficticio en la mente.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.explanation: 'Idealizar' يعني 'إلى idealize', attributing unrealistically perfect qualities إلى something أو someone. هو implies a distortion من reality through an overly positive lens, whereas 'imaginar' simply يعني إلى envision, و 'optimizar' يعني إلى optimize لـ efficiency.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.context: Literary character analysis in a creative writing workshop

q_vocab_c1_04_001.question: ماذا does 'Le saluda atentamente' يعني at الـ end من a رسمي letter?
q_vocab_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Le saluda atentamente' هو a standard لـmal closing في الإسبانية correspondence, equivalent إلى 'Yours sincerely' أو 'Yours faithfully'. هو يُستخدم في business و official letters.

q_vocab_c1_04_002.question: Me dirijo a usted con el fin de ___ información sobre el programa de becas.
q_vocab_c1_04_002.explanation: 'Solicitar' (إلى لـmally request) هو الـ appropriate فعل في لـmal correspondence. 'Me dirijo a usted con el fin de solicitar' يعني 'I am writing إلى أنت في order إلى request'. 'Pedir' سوف يكون too inلـmal لـ هذا register.

q_vocab_c1_04_003.question: ماذا does 'Estimado/a señor/a' يعني as a رسمي تحية?
q_vocab_c1_04_003.explanation: 'Estimado/a señor/a' هو الـ standard لـmal salutation في الإسبانية letters و emails, equivalent إلى 'Dear Sir/Madam'. 'Estimado' literally يعني 'esteemed' لكن functions as الـ conventional polite تحية.

q_vocab_c1_04_004.question: ما معنى 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas'؟
q_vocab_c1_04_004.correct: I apologize for the inconvenience caused
wrong: I am sorry for the occasion
q_vocab_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' هو a لـmal apology بمعنى 'I apologize لـ الـ inconvenience caused'. هو هو commonly used في business correspondence و customer service communications.

q_vocab_c1_04_005.question: I سوف يكون grateful if أنت could
q_vocab_c1_04_005.explanation: 'I سوف يكون grateful if أنت could' translates إلى 'Le agradecería que' متبوعاً بـ الـ صيغة المضارع المنصوب mood. هذا a polite hedging expression used في لـmal requests, considered more courteous than direct imperatives.

q_vocab_c1_04_006.question: ما معنى 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración'؟
q_vocab_c1_04_006.correct: I remain at your disposal for any clarification
wrong: I am quiet about the situation for now
I stay at the position of clarification
I remain disposed to any clearing
q_vocab_c1_04_006.explanation: 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' هو a لـmal closing phrase في business correspondence بمعنى 'I remain at لك disposal لـ any clarification'. هو signals willingness إلى provide further inلـmation.

q_vocab_c1_04_007.question: أنت هم writing a رسمي complaint إلى a company about defective merchandise. Which opening هو معظم appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_04_007.correct: Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad con el producto recibido.
wrong: Oigan, el producto que me mandaron está roto.
Quiero quejarme porque lo que compré no sirve.
Hola, tengo un problema con algo que pedí.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconلـmidad' يعني 'I am writing إلى أنت للتعبير my dissatisfaction'. هذا لـmal register مع 'disconلـmidad' (dissatisfaction) هو appropriate لـ official complaints, unlike الـ inلـmal alternatives.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.context: لـmal written complaint to a company

q_vocab_c1_04_008.question: ما معنى 'Rogamos disculpen la demora'؟
q_vocab_c1_04_008.correct: We kindly ask that you excuse the delay
wrong: We beg for your pardon for the damage
q_vocab_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' uses الـ لـmal 'rogar' (إلى request/beseech) مع صيغة المضارع المنصوب 'disculpen' إلى politely ask لـgiveness لـ a delay. 'Rogar' elevates الـ register beyond simply 'pedir disculpas'.

q_vocab_c1_04_009.question: sin perjuicio de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_04_009.correct: without prejudice to the foregoing / notwithstanding the above
q_vocab_c1_04_009.explanation: 'Sin perjuicio de lo anterior' هو a لـmal legal و administrative expression بمعنى 'بدون prejudice إلى الـ لـegoing' أو 'notwithstanding الـ above'. هو يُستخدم لـ state ذلك a new point does not invalidate previously mentioned terms.

q_vocab_c1_04_010.question: أنت هم drafting an email إلى a government ministry requesting an extension لـ a grant application deadline. Which phrasing demonstrates الـ appropriate رسمي hedging لغة?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.correct: Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de ampliar el plazo de presentación de solicitudes.
wrong: Necesito más tiempo, así que extienda la fecha.
Quiero que me den más días para entregar todo.
Oiga, no me da tiempo, ¿puede alargar el plazo?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de' هو an extremely لـmal construction بمعنى 'سوف أنت يكون so kind as إلى consider الـ possibility من'. هذا multi-layered hedging (الشرطي + polite phrase + possibility) shows الـ highest level من لـmal register appropriate لـ government correspondence.
q_vocab_c1_04_010.context: لـmal correspondence with a government ministry

q_vocab_c1_05_001.question: ماذا does 'mola' يعني في الإسبانية colloquial speech?
q_vocab_c1_05_001.explanation: 'Mola' comes من الـ فعل 'molar', which هو الإسبانية slang (primarily في Spain) بمعنى 'إلى يكون cool' أو 'إلى يكون awesome'. '¡Esa película mola mucho!' يعني 'ذلك movie هو really cool!'

q_vocab_c1_05_002.question: ماذا does 'currar' يعني في غير رسمي الإسبانية?
q_vocab_c1_05_002.explanation: 'Currar' هو الإسبانية slang بمعنى 'يعمل'. 'El curro' هو الـ slang اسم لـ 'work/job'. 'Estoy currando' يعني 'I'm working'. هذا جداً شائع في everyday speech في Spain.

q_vocab_c1_05_003.question: Se me quedó la mente en ___ durante el examen y no pude responder nada.
q_vocab_c1_05_003.explanation: 'Quedarse en blanco' يعني 'إلى go blank' أو 'إلى draw a blank'. الـ full expression describes الـ moment متى لك mind suddenly empties و أنت cannot remember anything, خاصة during stressful situations like exams.

q_vocab_c1_05_004.question: ماذا does 'flipar' يعني في colloquial الإسبانية?
q_vocab_c1_05_004.correct: to be amazed / to freak out / to be shocked
q_vocab_c1_05_004.explanation: 'Flipar' يعني 'إلى يكون amazed' أو 'إلى freak out' (في either a positive أو negative sense). '¡Estoy flipando!' يمكن يعني 'I يمكن't believe هو!' أو 'I'm blown away!' هو originated من الإنجليزية 'إلى flip out'.

q_vocab_c1_05_005.question: ما معنى 'pasarlo bomba'؟
q_vocab_c1_05_005.correct: to have a blast / to have a great time
wrong: to throw a bomb at a party
q_vocab_c1_05_005.explanation: 'Pasarlo bomba' هو a colloquial expression بمعنى 'إلى يملك a blast' أو 'إلى يملك an amazing وقت'. 'Lo pasamos bomba en la fiesta' يعني 'We had a blast at الـ party'. الـ 'bomba' metaphorically suggests explosive fun.

q_vocab_c1_05_006.question: إلى يكون fed up / إلى يكون sick من something
q_vocab_c1_05_006.explanation: 'إلى يكون fed up' translates إلى 'estar harto/a'. 'Estoy harto de esperar' يعني 'I'm fed up مع waiting'. بينما 'lleno' يعني physically full, 'harto' conveys emotional saturation و frustration.

q_vocab_c1_05_007.question: ماذا does 'tío/tía' يعني متى used as slang (not literally)?
q_vocab_c1_05_007.correct: dude / mate / pal (informal way to address someone)
wrong: a rude way to address a stranger
a formal title for elderly people
q_vocab_c1_05_007.explanation: 'Tío/tía' literally يعني 'uncle/aunt' لكن في colloquial الإسبانية (خاصة في Spain), هو functions as 'dude', 'mate', أو 'pal'. '¡Eh, tío, ¿qué tal?!' يعني 'Hey dude, كيف's هو going?!'

q_vocab_c1_05_008.question: ir de cañas
q_vocab_c1_05_008.correct: to go out for beers / to go bar-hopping for draft beers
wrong: to go to the sugar cane fields
q_vocab_c1_05_008.explanation: 'Ir de cañas' يعني 'إلى go out لـ beers', specifically صغير draft beers ('cañas'). هو هو a quintessential الإسبانية social activity involving visiting several bars و having a صغير beer at each one.

q_vocab_c1_05_009.question: لك الإسبانية friend says '¡Qué fuerte!' بعد hearing surprising news. ماذا register و المعنى does هذا expression convey?
q_vocab_c1_05_009.correct: It is an informal exclamation expressing shock or disbelief, meaning 'No way!' or 'That's crazy!'
wrong: It is a formal expression meaning the news is physically strong.
It means the news is about someone who is very powerful.
It is a medical term meaning the person feels strong.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.explanation: '¡Qué fuerte!' هو a جداً شائع colloquial exclamation في Spain used للتعبير surprise, shock, أو disbelief. Literally بمعنى 'كيف strong!', هو functions like 'No way!' أو 'ذلك's crazy!' في inلـmal conversation.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.context: Casual conversation reacting to surprising news

q_vocab_c1_05_010.question: A group من friends هو planning a Saturday night out. One says: 'Vamos a ir de marcha y lo vamos a pasar genial.' ماذا does هذا يعني و ماذا register هو هو?
q_vocab_c1_05_010.correct: Informal register: 'We're going to go out partying and we're going to have a great time.'
wrong: Formal register: 'We are going on a march and it will be wonderful.'
Neutral register: 'We are leaving on a journey and will arrive safely.'
Military register: 'We are starting a march and will complete it successfully.'
q_vocab_c1_05_010.explanation: 'Ir de marcha' هو colloquial لـ 'إلى go out partying' أو 'إلى go out on الـ town'. Combined مع 'pasarlo genial' (إلى يملك a great وقت), هذا typical inلـmal youth لغة في Spain لـ planning a ليل out.
q_vocab_c1_05_010.context: Friends making weekend plans via group chat

q_vocab_c1_06_001.question: ماذا does الـ proverb 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' يعني?
q_vocab_c1_06_001.correct: Every cloud has a silver lining
wrong: There is no evil that comes from good
Bad things never happen to good people
No harm comes without a warning
q_vocab_c1_06_001.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' literally يعني 'هناك no bad ذلك does not come لـ جيد'. هو هو equivalent إلى 'Every cloud يملك a silver lining', expressing الـ idea ذلك something positive يمكن emerge من negative situations.

q_vocab_c1_06_002.question: Más vale ___ que nunca, así que empecemos el proyecto ahora.
q_vocab_c1_06_002.explanation: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' يعني 'Better late than أبداً'. الـ sentence يعني 'Better late than أبداً, so let's start الـ project now.' هذا proverb encourages action even متى delayed.

q_vocab_c1_06_003.question: ما معنى 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda'؟
q_vocab_c1_06_003.correct: The early bird catches the worm / God helps those who rise early
wrong: God helps those who are mature
q_vocab_c1_06_003.explanation: 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' literally يعني 'God helps those من rise early'. الـ فعل 'madrugar' يعني 'إلى get up early'. هو هو equivalent إلى الـ الإنجليزية proverb 'الـ early bird catches الـ worm', emphasizing diligence.

q_vocab_c1_06_004.question: ما معنى 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas'؟
q_vocab_c1_06_004.correct: Silence is golden / It's better to keep quiet
wrong: You should close your mouth when flies are near
Insects are attracted to open mouths
q_vocab_c1_06_004.explanation: 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' literally يعني 'Flies don't enter a closed mouth'. هو advises discretion و الـ wisdom من keeping quiet إلى avoid trouble, similar إلى 'Silence هو golden'.

q_vocab_c1_06_005.question: don't look a gift horse في الـ mouth
q_vocab_c1_06_005.correct: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
wrong: No mires al caballo en la boca del regalo
El caballo del regalo tiene dientes malos
Regalar un caballo es mirar sus dientes
q_vocab_c1_06_005.explanation: 'A caballo regalado no le mires el diente' هو الـ exact الإسبانية equivalent من 'Don't look a gift horse في الـ mouth'. Both proverbs advise being grateful لـ gifts بدون criticizing their quality.

q_vocab_c1_06_006.question: ماذا يعني 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta'؟
q_vocab_c1_06_006.correct: من يطمع في الكثير يخسر كل شيء / صاحب بالين كذّاب
wrong: العناقات الكبيرة لا تكون محكمة أبدًا
من يمدّ يده بعيدًا يضغط قليلًا
q_vocab_c1_06_006.explanation: 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' تعني حرفيًا 'من يحتضن الكثير يضغط القليل'. وهو مثل يحذّر من تولّي مهام أو مسؤوليات كثيرة في وقت واحد، إذ لن يُنجَز أي منها على الوجه الصحيح.

q_vocab_c1_06_007.question: A colleague يملك been complaining about their job لكن refuses إلى look لـ a new one. Which proverb سوف يكون معظم fitting advice?
q_vocab_c1_06_007.correct: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' -- You have to take risks to achieve results.
wrong: 'Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando' -- Keep what you already have.
'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' -- Ignore the problem.
'Perro ladrador, poco mordedor' -- The complaints are harmless.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.explanation: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' يعني 'Nothing ventured, nothing gained'. هو encourages someone إلى take calculated risks rather than remaining في an unsatisfactory situation, which هو appropriate advice لـ someone afraid إلى seek change.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.context: Giving career advice to a dissatisfied صديق

q_vocab_c1_06_008.question: ما معنى 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres'؟
q_vocab_c1_06_008.correct: You are known by the company you keep / Tell me who your friends are and I'll tell you who you are
wrong: Tell me where you walk and I'll tell you who you are
Walk with me and I'll know your name
Show me your path and I'll show you mine
q_vocab_c1_06_008.explanation: 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' literally يعني 'Tell me من أنت walk مع و I'll tell أنت من أنت هم'. هو emphasizes ذلك الناس هم judged بواسطة their associations و friendships.

q_vocab_c1_06_009.question: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente
q_vocab_c1_06_009.correct: Out of sight, out of mind
wrong: Eyes that don't see have no feelings
The heart cannot see what the eyes feel
q_vocab_c1_06_009.explanation: 'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' literally يعني 'Eyes ذلك don't see, heart ذلك doesn't feel'. هو هو equivalent إلى 'Out من sight, out من mind', suggesting ذلك not knowing about something prevents emotional pain.

q_vocab_c1_06_010.question: A student fails an exam لكن discovers ذلك الـ failure motivated them إلى change their study habits, leading إلى much better grades. Which proverb perfectly describes هذا situation?
q_vocab_c1_06_010.correct: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' -- The setback ultimately led to improvement.
wrong: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' -- They studied late but passed.
'El saber no ocupa lugar' -- Knowledge takes up no space.
'A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan' -- Smart students need fewer words.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' (Every cloud يملك a silver lining) perfectly describes كيف a negative event (failing الـ exam) led إلى a positive outcome (improved study habits و better grades). الـ proverb captures الـ transلـmative potential من adversity.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.context: Reflecting on academic setbacks and personal growth

q_vocab_c1_07_001.question: ماذا does 'el rendimiento' يعني في a business context?
q_vocab_c1_07_001.explanation: 'El rendimiento' في business يعني 'perلـmance', 'yield', أو 'productivity'. 'El rendimiento del equipo' يعني 'team perلـmance', و 'rendimiento de la inversión' يعني 'return on investment'.

q_vocab_c1_07_002.question: ماذا does 'el flujo de trabajo' يعني في a professional setting?
wrong: the flow of water at work
q_vocab_c1_07_002.explanation: 'El flujo de trabajo' يعني 'workflow', الـ sequence من processes through which a piece من work passes من initiation إلى completion. هو هو a standard term في project management و business operations.

q_vocab_c1_07_003.question: La empresa necesita ___ su modelo de negocio para adaptarse al mercado digital.
q_vocab_c1_07_003.explanation: 'Reestructurar' يعني 'إلى restructure', specifically referring إلى reorganizing a company's operations, finances, أو strategy. الـ sentence يعني 'الـ company needs إلى restructure its business model إلى adapt إلى الـ digital market.'

q_vocab_c1_07_004.question: ماذا does 'la escalabilidad' يعني في هو و business?
q_vocab_c1_07_004.explanation: 'La escalabilidad' يعني 'scalability', الـ capacity من a system, network, أو business إلى handle growing amounts من work أو إلى expand. هو هو a critical concept في technology startups و software development.

q_vocab_c1_07_005.question: ماذا does 'el titular' يعني في journalism?
q_vocab_c1_07_005.explanation: 'El titular' في journalism يعني 'headline', الـ title من a newspaper أداة تعريف designed إلى capture الـ reader's attention. هو يمكن أيضاً يعني 'title holder' في other contexts, لكن في media, هو يشير إلى headlines.

q_vocab_c1_07_006.question: stakeholder
q_vocab_c1_07_006.explanation: 'Stakeholder' translates إلى 'la parte interesada' أو 'el interesado' في الإسبانية. Unlike 'accionista' (shareholder), a stakeholder هو any party مع an interest في أو affected بواسطة a business أو project.

q_vocab_c1_07_007.question: ماذا does 'externalizar' يعني في business terminology?
q_vocab_c1_07_007.explanation: 'Externalizar' يعني 'إلى outsource', الـ practice من contracting business processes أو functions إلى external companies. 'La empresa decidió externalizar el servicio de atención al cliente' يعني 'الـ company decided إلى outsource customer service'.

q_vocab_c1_07_008.question: la competencia desleal
q_vocab_c1_07_008.explanation: 'La competencia desleal' يعني 'unfair competition', business practices ذلك هم deceptive, fraudulent, أو otherwise unfair إلى competitors. هو هو a legal concept في commercial law.

q_vocab_c1_07_009.question: A software development team هو discussing كيف إلى handle a product launch ذلك keeps getting delayed. الـ project manager suggests adopting a new approach. Which professional term describes هذا methodology?
q_vocab_c1_07_009.correct: Implementar una metodología ágil para iterar más rápidamente.
wrong: Cancelar el proyecto y empezar uno nuevo.
Despedir a todos los desarrolladores del equipo.
Ignorar los plazos y lanzar cuando esté listo.
q_vocab_c1_07_009.explanation: 'Metodología ágil' يعني 'agile methodology', an iterative approach إلى project management و software development ذلك delivers work في صغير increments. 'Iterar' يعني 'إلى iterate', making incremental improvements through repeated cycles.

q_vocab_c1_07_010.question: A journalist needs إلى protect الـ identity من a source من provided sensitive information about corporate corruption. Which professional principle applies?
q_vocab_c1_07_010.correct: El secreto profesional obliga a proteger la identidad de las fuentes confidenciales.
wrong: La ley obliga a revelar todas las fuentes en cualquier caso.
El periodista debe publicar el nombre completo de la fuente.
Las fuentes anónimas no son válidas en el periodismo.
q_vocab_c1_07_010.explanation: 'El secreto profesional' يعني 'professional secrecy' أو 'source protection'. في journalism, هذا ethical principle protects الـ identity من confidential sources ('fuentes confidenciales'), which هو fundamental إلى press freedom و investigative reporting.

q_vocab_c1_08_001.question: ماذا does 'la trascendencia' يعني في philosophical discourse?
q_vocab_c1_08_001.explanation: 'La trascendencia' يعني 'transcendence' أو 'far-reaching significance'. في philosophy, هو يشير إلى الـ aspect من existence ذلك goes beyond الـ ordinary أو physical realm. في everyday usage, هو يعني lasting importance.

q_vocab_c1_08_002.question: El concepto de ___ ha sido debatido por filósofos durante siglos.
q_vocab_c1_08_002.explanation: 'Identidad' يعني 'identity'. الـ sentence يعني 'الـ concept من identity يملك been debated بواسطة philosophers لـ centuries.' Identity هو a core abstract concept في philosophy, psychology, و sociology.

q_vocab_c1_08_003.question: ما معنى 'el paradigma'؟
q_vocab_c1_08_003.correct: paradigm / model of thought or understanding
q_vocab_c1_08_003.explanation: 'El paradigma' يعني 'paradigm', a framework من thought, a model من understanding, أو a set من accepted beliefs ذلك defines a field. 'Un cambio de paradigma' (a paradigm shift) يشير إلى a fundamental change في approach أو underlying assumptions.

q_vocab_c1_08_004.question: ماذا does 'la conciencia' يعني متى used as an abstract concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_004.explanation: 'La conciencia' as an abstract concept يملك dual بمعنىs: 'consciousness' (philosophical awareness من existence) و 'conscience' (moral awareness). 'Tomar conciencia' يعني 'إلى become aware' أو 'إلى raise awareness'.

q_vocab_c1_08_005.question: inherent / intrinsic
q_vocab_c1_08_005.explanation: 'Inherent' أو 'intrinsic' translates إلى 'intrínseco' في الإسبانية. هو describes a quality ذلك هو essential و permanent, belonging naturally إلى something: 'el valor intrínseco' (intrinsic value).

q_vocab_c1_08_006.question: ماذا does 'la equidad' يعني, و كيف does هو differ من 'la igualdad'?
q_vocab_c1_08_006.correct: equity / fairness; it means providing what each person needs, while 'igualdad' means giving everyone the same
wrong: 'Equidad' means horse riding and 'igualdad' means equality
'Equidad' is an economic term and 'igualdad' is a social one only
q_vocab_c1_08_006.explanation: 'La equidad' يعني 'equity' أو 'fairness', providing resources based on individual needs إلى achieve fair outcomes. 'La igualdad' يعني 'equality', treating everyone الـ same. الـ distinction هو crucial في social justice discourse.

q_vocab_c1_08_007.question: A philosopher argues ذلك human freedom هو inseparable من responsibility. Which abstract concept هو central إلى هذا argument?
q_vocab_c1_08_007.correct: La autonomía: la capacidad del individuo de gobernarse a sí mismo implica asumir las consecuencias de sus actos.
wrong: La dependencia: el ser humano depende de otros para actuar.
La obediencia: la libertad consiste en seguir las reglas establecidas.
La indiferencia: la libertad y la responsabilidad no están relacionadas.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.explanation: 'La autonomía' يعني 'autonomy', الـ capacity لـ self-governance. الـ philosophical connection between freedom و responsibility هو rooted في autonomy: being free إلى choose يعني being accountable لـ those choices.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.context: Philosophy seminar on existentialism and ethics

q_vocab_c1_08_008.question: ماذا does 'la resiliencia' يعني as an abstract psychological concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_008.correct: resilience / the ability to recover from adversity
q_vocab_c1_08_008.explanation: 'La resiliencia' يعني 'resilience', الـ psychological capacity إلى recover من difficulties و adapt إلى challenging circumstances. هو يملك become a central concept في psychology, education, و personal development.

q_vocab_c1_08_009.question: la alteridad
q_vocab_c1_08_009.correct: otherness / the quality of being different or other
q_vocab_c1_08_009.explanation: 'La alteridad' يعني 'otherness', a philosophical concept ذلك يشير إلى الـ recognition من الـ 'other' as fundamentally different من oneself. هو هو central إلى ethics, particularly في الـ philosophy من Emmanuel Levinas.

q_vocab_c1_08_010.question: Two debaters هم discussing whether morality هو universal أو culturally determined. Which pair من abstract concepts frames هذا debate?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.correct: El universalismo moral frente al relativismo cultural: ¿existen valores absolutos o dependen del contexto?
wrong: El capitalismo frente al socialismo: ¿quién tiene más dinero?
El optimismo frente al pesimismo: ¿quién es más feliz?
La ciencia frente a la religión: ¿quién tiene la verdad?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.explanation: 'El universalismo moral' (moral universalism) holds ذلك certain ethical principles apply إلى كل humans, بينما 'el relativismo cultural' (cultural relativism) argues ذلك moral standards هم shaped بواسطة culture. هذا one من الـ معظم fundamental debates في ethics.

q_vocab_c1_09_001.question: ماذا does 'la metáfora' يعني as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_001.correct: metaphor -- a figure of speech that directly compares two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as'
wrong: a physical transformation of one thing into another
q_vocab_c1_09_001.explanation: 'La metáلـa' هو a rhetorical device في which one thing هو described as being another: 'La vida es un viaje' (Life هو a journey). Unlike a simile, a metaphor does not use 'como' (like/as).

q_vocab_c1_09_002.question: ماذا does 'la ironía' يعني as a literary device?
q_vocab_c1_09_002.correct: irony -- saying the opposite of what is meant, or a contrast between expectation and reality
q_vocab_c1_09_002.explanation: 'La ironía' encompasses verbal irony (saying الـ opposite من ماذا أنت يعني), situational irony (متى الـ outcome هو opposite إلى expectations), و dramatic irony (متى الـ audience knows something الـ characters don't).

q_vocab_c1_09_003.question: El orador usó una ___ al decir que había esperado 'un millón de años' para recibir la respuesta.
q_vocab_c1_09_003.explanation: 'Hipérbole' يعني 'hyperbole', a deliberate exaggeration لـ emphasis أو effect. Saying 'a million years' لوصف a wait هو a clear مثال من hyperbole, not meant إلى يكون taken literally.

q_vocab_c1_09_004.question: ما معنى 'el eufemismo'؟
q_vocab_c1_09_004.correct: euphemism -- a mild or indirect expression used to replace one considered too harsh or blunt
q_vocab_c1_09_004.explanation: 'El eufemismo' هو a rhetorical device ذلك substitutes a mild expression لـ something considered offensive أو unpleasant. لـ مثال, 'pasar a mejor vida' (إلى pass إلى a better life) instead من 'morir' (إلى die).

q_vocab_c1_09_005.question: ما معنى 'el oxímoron'؟
q_vocab_c1_09_005.correct: oxymoron -- a figure of speech combining contradictory terms
wrong: a contradiction that is always an error
a figure of speech using repetition
q_vocab_c1_09_005.explanation: 'El oxímoron' هو a rhetorical device ذلك places two contradictory terms together لـ effect: 'un silencio ensordecedor' (a deafening silence), 'la oscura claridad' (dark clarity). هو creates striking imagery through paradox.

q_vocab_c1_09_006.question: understatement / deliberate minimization
q_vocab_c1_09_006.explanation: 'Understatement' translates إلى 'la litotes' أو 'la atenuación'. Litotes هو الـ opposite من hyperbole -- هو deliberately understates something لـ ironic effect. 'No es mala idea' (هو's not a bad idea) متى بمعنى 'هو's a great idea' هو litotes.

q_vocab_c1_09_007.question: ماذا does 'la antítesis' يعني as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_007.correct: antithesis -- juxtaposing contrasting ideas in a balanced structure
wrong: the answer to a thesis question
a statement that destroys an argument
q_vocab_c1_09_007.explanation: 'La antítesis' places two opposing ideas side بواسطة side في a parallel structure لـ emphasis: 'Es tan corto el amor y tan largo el olvido' (Love هو so brief و لـgetting هو so long) -- Pablo Neruda. هو creates a powerful rhetorical contrast.

q_vocab_c1_09_008.question: la sinécdoque
q_vocab_c1_09_008.correct: synecdoche -- a figure of speech where a part represents the whole, or the whole represents a part
q_vocab_c1_09_008.explanation: 'La sinécdoque' هو a figure من speech أين a part stands لـ الـ whole أو vice versa. لـ مثال, 'Necesitamos más manos' (We need more hands) أين 'hands' represents workers/الناس.

q_vocab_c1_09_009.question: A political speech states: 'We bring not war, لكن peace; not destruction, لكن creation; not despair, لكن hope.' Which rhetorical device هو primarily being employed?
q_vocab_c1_09_009.correct: La antítesis con anáfora: la repetición de una estructura que contrasta ideas opuestas.
wrong: La hipérbole: una exageración deliberada de los hechos.
El eufemismo: una suavización del lenguaje directo.
La metonimia: la sustitución de un término por otro relacionado.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.explanation: الـ speech uses 'antítesis' (antithesis) بواسطة juxtaposing opposing pairs (war/peace, destruction/creation, despair/hope) و 'anáلـa' (anaphora) through الـ repetition من 'not ... لكن'. Together, these devices create a powerful rhythmic و persuasive effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.context: Analyzing rhetorical strategies in political discourse

q_vocab_c1_09_010.question: A writer describes a cruel character as 'having a heart من gold' إلى highlight الـ gap between appearance و reality. Which rhetorical device هو being used?
q_vocab_c1_09_010.correct: La ironía: el escritor dice lo contrario de lo que quiere comunicar para crear un efecto de contraste.
wrong: La metáfora: el escritor describe literalmente que el corazón es de oro.
La hipérbole: el escritor exagera la bondad del personaje.
El eufemismo: el escritor suaviza la crueldad del personaje.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.explanation: هذا 'ironía' (irony) لأن الـ description 'heart من gold' directly contradicts الـ character's actual cruelty. الـ reader understands الـ intended بمعنى هو الـ opposite من الـ literal words, creating a powerful critical effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.context: Literary analysis of character portrayal techniques

q_vocab_c1_10_001.question: ماذا does 'la corrida de toros' refer إلى في الإسبانية culture?
q_vocab_c1_10_001.explanation: 'La corrida de toros' يعني 'bullfight', a traditional spectacle في Spain involving a matador و a bull. هو هو a highly controversial cultural practice, celebrated بواسطة some as art و criticized بواسطة others as animal cruelty.

q_vocab_c1_10_002.question: Don Quijote es considerado la primera novela ___ de la literatura occidental.
q_vocab_c1_10_002.explanation: 'Don Quijote de la Mancha' بواسطة Miguel de Cervantes (1605/1615) هو widely considered الـ first modern novel. هو introduced innovations like metafiction, unreliable narration, و complex character psychology ذلك defined modern literature.

q_vocab_c1_10_003.question: ماذا does 'el flamenco' encompass as a cultural art form?
q_vocab_c1_10_003.correct: a combination of singing (cante), dancing (baile), and guitar playing (toque) originating from Andalusia
wrong: only a type of bird native to Spain
exclusively a musical genre with no dance
a form of bullfighting from Madrid
q_vocab_c1_10_003.explanation: 'El flamenco' هو a comprehensive art لـm من Andalusia comprising ثلاثة elements: 'cante' (singing), 'baile' (dance), و 'toque' (guitar playing). هو كان declared UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage في 2010.

q_vocab_c1_10_004.question: ماذا does 'la siesta' represent culturally في Spain?
q_vocab_c1_10_004.correct: a traditional midday rest or nap, reflecting the adaptation to hot climate and a social rhythm centered on extended lunch
wrong: a type of festival celebrated in summer
a Spanish holiday on the seventh day
q_vocab_c1_10_004.explanation: 'La siesta' هو a brief midday rest traditionally taken بعد lunch. هو reflects Spain's Mediterranean climate adaptation و a social structure أين lunch هو الـ main meal. Though declining في modern urban life, هو remains culturally significant.

q_vocab_c1_10_005.question: الـ Camino de Santiago (cultural/historical المعنى)
q_vocab_c1_10_005.correct: el Camino de Santiago: an ancient pilgrimage route to the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
wrong: el Camino de Santiago: a modern highway in northern Spain
el Camino de Santiago: a famous Spanish restaurant chain
el Camino de Santiago: a type of traditional Spanish dance
q_vocab_c1_10_005.explanation: 'El Camino de Santiago' (الـ Way من St. James) هو one من الـ معظم important Christian pilgrimage routes, leading إلى الـ Cathedral من Santiago de Compostela في Galicia. هو يملك been a UNESCO World Heritage Site بما أن 1993 و attracts hundreds من thousands من pilgrims و hikers annually.

q_vocab_c1_10_006.question: إلامَ تشير 'La Tomatina'؟
q_vocab_c1_10_006.correct: مهرجان سنوي لرشق الطماطم يُقام في بونيول بمنطقة بلنسية
wrong: احتفال بحصاد الطماطم في أنحاء إسبانيا كلها
حساء طماطم تقليدي يُقدَّم في عيد الميلاد
q_vocab_c1_10_006.explanation: 'La Tomatina' مهرجان شهير يُقام سنويًا في آخر أربعاء من شهر أغسطس في بونيول بمنطقة بلنسية. يتراشق المشاركون بالطماطم فيما أصبح أكبر معركة طعام في العالم، ويجذب زوارًا من مختلف أنحاء العالم.

q_vocab_c1_10_007.question: A tour guide explains الـ significance من 'las tapas' إلى foreign visitors. Which description best captures الـ cultural المعنى beyond just food?
q_vocab_c1_10_007.correct: Las tapas represent a social dining culture of sharing small dishes, encouraging conversation and community bonding.
wrong: Tapas are simply appetizers served before the main course.
Tapas are the main meal of the day in Spain.
Tapas are only served in formal restaurants for tourists.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.explanation: 'Las tapas' transcend mere طعام -- هم embody a social ritual من sharing صغير dishes ('ir de tapas') ذلك fosters conversation, community, و leisurely dining. الـ practice reflects Spain's emphasis on socializing و shared experiences over لـmal, individualized dining.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.context: Cultural tour explaining Spanish social customs

q_vocab_c1_10_008.question: ماذا does 'el Día de los Muertos' refer إلى, و which country هو هو معظم associated مع?
q_vocab_c1_10_008.correct: Day of the Dead, a Mexican celebration honoring deceased loved ones on November 1-2
wrong: A Spanish holiday celebrating Halloween on October 31
A religious fast observed in all Latin American countries
A day of mourning observed only in cemeteries
q_vocab_c1_10_008.explanation: 'El Día de los Muertos' (Day من الـ Dead) هو a Mexican tradition (not الإسبانية) on November 1-2 أين families create altars ('ofrendas'), visit cemeteries, و celebrate الـ lives من deceased loved ones. هو كان recognized بواسطة UNESCO في 2008.

q_vocab_c1_10_009.question: Las Fallas de Valencia
q_vocab_c1_10_009.correct: an annual Valencian festival featuring the construction and burning of large artistic sculptures
wrong: a volcanic eruption festival in the Canary Islands
a traditional Valencia orange harvest celebration
a failure commemoration in Valencian history
q_vocab_c1_10_009.explanation: 'Las Fallas' هو a major festival في Valencia celebrated around March 15-19 (Saint Joseph's Day). Neighborhoods build enormous artistic sculptures ('ninots'), which هم then burned on الـ final ليل ('la cremà'). هو هو a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

q_vocab_c1_10_010.question: A student هو writing an essay about كيف Gabriel García Márquez's 'Cien años de soledad' reflects Latin American cultural identity. Which literary و cultural concept ينبغي يكون central إلى their analysis?
q_vocab_c1_10_010.correct: El realismo mágico: la fusión de elementos fantásticos con la realidad cotidiana latinoamericana.
wrong: El naturalismo: la descripción científica y objetiva de la realidad.
El romanticismo: la exaltación de los sentimientos individuales europeos.
El existencialismo: la angustia del ser humano ante la libertad.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.explanation: 'El realismo mágico' (magical realism) هو a literary genre أين magical elements appear naturally within a realistic setting. García Márquez's masterpiece هو its quintessential مثال, reflecting Latin American cultural identity through mythology, oral tradition, و الـ blending من الـ extraordinary مع الـ everyday.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.context: University literature essay on Latin American cultural identity

q_vocab_c1_11_001.question: ماذا هو الـ register difference between 'empezar', 'comenzar', و 'iniciar'?
q_vocab_c1_11_001.correct: 'Empezar' is informal/neutral, 'comenzar' is slightly more formal, and 'iniciar' is the most formal/technical
wrong: All three are identical with no register difference
'Iniciar' is the most informal and 'empezar' is the most formal
'Comenzar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_11_001.explanation: These ثلاثة synonyms لـ 'إلى begin/start' vary في register: 'empezar' (everyday), 'comenzar' (slightly elevated, literary), 'iniciar' (لـmal, technical, administrative). Choosing الـ right one demonstrates register awareness at C1 level.

q_vocab_c1_11_002.question: ماذا هو الـ precise difference between 'efectivo' و 'eficaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_002.correct: 'Eficaz' means achieving the desired result; 'efectivo' means actually producing a real effect in practice
wrong: They are perfect synonyms with no distinction
'Eficaz' refers to money and 'efectivo' refers to results
'Efectivo' is only used in military contexts
q_vocab_c1_11_002.explanation: 'Eficaz' (efficacious) focuses on الـ capacity إلى produce الـ intended result, بينما 'efectivo' (effective) emphasizes ذلك something actually works في practice. A treatment يمكن أن يكون 'eficaz' في theory لكن not 'efectivo' في real-world application.

q_vocab_c1_11_003.question: El gobierno implementó medidas ___ para reducir la contaminación atmosférica.
q_vocab_c1_11_003.explanation: 'Drásticas' يعني 'drastic' (severe و far-reaching measures). بينما 'dramáticas' (dramatic) و 'trágicas' (tragic) exist as false friends, 'drástico' specifically يشير إلى extreme measures taken إلى solve a مشكلة. الـ sentence يعني 'الـ government implemented drastic measures إلى reduce air pollution.'

q_vocab_c1_11_004.question: ماذا هو الـ difference between 'austero' و 'sobrio'?
q_vocab_c1_11_004.correct: 'Austero' means strictly simple, avoiding luxury; 'sobrio' means restrained, moderate, and elegant in simplicity
wrong: 'Austero' is positive and 'sobrio' is always negative
q_vocab_c1_11_004.explanation: 'Austero' (austere) implies strictness و الـ deliberate avoidance من luxury أو comلـt: 'una vida austera'. 'Sobrio' (sober/restrained) implies tasteful restraint و moderation بدون excess: 'un estilo sobrio'. Both convey simplicity لكن مع different connotations.

q_vocab_c1_11_005.question: ماذا هو الـ advanced antonym من 'elogiar' (إلى praise)?
q_vocab_c1_11_005.explanation: 'Vituperar' و 'denostar' هم elevated antonyms من 'elogiar'. بينما 'criticar' هو a شائع-level antonym, 'vituperar' (إلى vilify) و 'denostar' (إلى revile/defame) represent الـ strongest opposition إلى praise, conveying harsh و public condemnation.

q_vocab_c1_11_006.question: إلى worsen / إلى deteriorate
q_vocab_c1_11_006.explanation: 'إلى worsen' يمكن أن يكون translated as 'empeorar' (general), 'deteriorarse' (gradual decline في condition), أو 'agravarse' (becoming more serious, غالباً medical/crisis). Each يملك different connotations: 'La situación se agravó' (الـ situation worsened -- became critical).

q_vocab_c1_11_007.question: ماذا هو الـ nuanced difference between 'perspicaz' و 'sagaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_007.correct: 'Perspicaz' means perceptive/sharp-sighted (seeing details clearly); 'sagaz' means shrewd/astute (using insight strategically)
q_vocab_c1_11_007.explanation: 'Perspicaz' (perspicacious) emphasizes keen perception و الـ ability إلى notice subtle details. 'Sagaz' (sagacious/shrewd) implies using ذلك perception strategically لـ practical advantage. A detective هو 'perspicaz' متى noticing clues و 'sagaz' متى connecting them إلى solve الـ case.

q_vocab_c1_11_008.question: escueto
q_vocab_c1_11_008.explanation: 'Escueto' يعني 'concise', 'terse', أو 'succinct', describing something ذلك هو brief و free من unnecessary detail. 'Una respuesta escueta' هو a brief, no-frills answer. هو يمكن أن يكون neutral أو slightly negative (implying too brief).

q_vocab_c1_11_009.question: أنت هم writing a رسمي report و need لقول ذلك a policy 'failed completely.' Which synonym هو معظم appropriate لـ رسمي register?
q_vocab_c1_11_009.correct: 'La política fracasó rotundamente' -- using 'fracasar rotundamente' for emphatic formal failure.
wrong: 'La política falló totalmente' -- too informal for a report.
'La política fue un desastre completo' -- too colloquial.
'La política no funcionó para nada' -- too conversational.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.explanation: 'Fracasar rotundamente' يعني 'إلى fail resoundingly'. في لـmal writing, 'fracasar' (إلى fail) هو more appropriate than 'fallar' (more mechanical/inلـmal), و 'rotundamente' (categorically/resoundingly) هو a stronger لـmal ظرف than 'totalmente' أو 'completamente'.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.context: Writing a لـmal policy evaluation report

q_vocab_c1_11_010.question: A literary critic needs لوصف a novel's writing style ذلك هو excessively ornate و over-الـ-top. Which pair من synonyms و antonyms سوف best frame هذا critique?
q_vocab_c1_11_010.explanation: 'Recargado' (overloaded/ornate) و 'ampuloso' (pompous/bombastic) precisely describe an excessively decorated writing style. Their antonyms 'sobrio' (restrained) و 'escueto' (succinct) represent الـ opposite aesthetic. هذا vocabulary هو essential لـ advanced literary criticism.

q_vocab_c1_12_001.question: ماذا does الـ collocation 'tomar una decisión' يعني?
q_vocab_c1_12_001.explanation: 'Tomar una decisión' يعني 'إلى make a decision'. في الإسبانية, decisions هم 'taken' (tomar) rather than 'made' (hacer). هذا one من الـ معظم important collocations إلى learn, as 'hacer una decisión' هو incorrect.

q_vocab_c1_12_002.question: El profesor hizo ___ en la importancia de la participación activa en clase.
q_vocab_c1_12_002.explanation: 'Hacer hincapié en' يعني 'إلى emphasize' أو 'إلى stress'. الـ sentence يعني 'الـ professor emphasized الـ importance من active participation في class.' هذا a fixed collocation -- 'hincapié' هو rarely used outside هذا expression.

q_vocab_c1_12_003.question: ماذا does الـ collocation 'prestar atención' يعني?
q_vocab_c1_12_003.explanation: 'Prestar atención' يعني 'إلى pay attention'. في الإسبانية, attention هو 'lent' (prestar) rather than 'paid'. 'Presta atención a lo que dice el profesor' يعني 'Pay attention إلى ماذا الـ معلم says.'

q_vocab_c1_12_004.question: ما معنى 'correr el riesgo'؟
q_vocab_c1_12_004.correct: to run the risk / to take the risk
wrong: to escape the risk by running
q_vocab_c1_12_004.explanation: 'Correr el riesgo' يعني 'يركض الـ risk' أو 'إلى take الـ risk'. 'Si no actúas ahora, corres el riesgo de perder la oportunidad' يعني 'If أنت don't act now, أنت run الـ risk من losing الـ opportunity.'

q_vocab_c1_12_005.question: إلى file a complaint
q_vocab_c1_12_005.correct: presentar una queja / interponer una reclamación
wrong: poner una queja en un archivo
q_vocab_c1_12_005.explanation: 'إلى file a complaint' translates إلى 'presentar una queja' (general) أو 'interponer una reclamación' (لـmal/legal). الـ فعل 'interponer' هو specifically used في legal و administrative contexts لـ لـmal claims.

q_vocab_c1_12_006.question: ما معنى 'dar por sentado'؟
q_vocab_c1_12_006.explanation: 'Dar por sentado' يعني 'إلى take لـ granted', إلى assume something بدون questioning هو. 'No des por sentado que todos están de acuerdo' يعني 'Don't take لـ granted ذلك everyone agrees.'

q_vocab_c1_12_007.question: A manager tells an employee: 'Hay que poner en marcha el proyecto antes de fin de mes.' ماذا does 'poner en marcha' يعني?
q_vocab_c1_12_007.correct: to launch / to set in motion / to get something started
wrong: to put something on a march
q_vocab_c1_12_007.explanation: 'Poner en marcha' يعني 'إلى launch', 'إلى set في motion', أو 'إلى get something started'. هو هو a شائع business collocation لـ initiating projects, plans, أو processes. الـ manager هو saying الـ project يجب أن يكون launched beلـe الـ end من الـ month.

q_vocab_c1_12_008.question: ما معنى 'llevar a cabo'؟
q_vocab_c1_12_008.correct: to carry out / to accomplish / to execute
wrong: to carry to the end of a rope
to bring to a finish line
q_vocab_c1_12_008.explanation: 'Llevar a cabo' يعني 'إلى carry out' أو 'إلى accomplish'. هو هو a لـmal collocation used لـ completing tasks, projects, أو plans: 'Llevaron a cabo una investigación exhaustiva' (هم carried out an exhaustive investigation).

q_vocab_c1_12_009.question: hacer caso omiso de
wrong: to make a house out of something
q_vocab_c1_12_009.explanation: 'Hacer caso omiso de' يعني 'إلى disregard' أو 'إلى deliberately ignore'. هو implies a conscious choice إلى overlook something: 'Hizo caso omiso de las advertencias' (He disregarded الـ warnings). هو هو more لـmal than simply 'ignorar'.

q_vocab_c1_12_010.question: A research team presents their findings إلى stakeholders. الـ lead researcher says: 'Los resultados arrojan luz sobre un fenómeno hasta ahora desconocido.' ماذا does 'arrojar luz sobre' يعني و why هو هو significant?
q_vocab_c1_12_010.correct: 'Arrojar luz sobre' means 'to shed light on' -- it indicates the research has clarified or revealed something previously unknown.
wrong: It means the research literally produced light during an experiment.
It means the results are too bright and need to be dimmed.
It means throwing a spotlight at an audience during a presentation.
q_vocab_c1_12_010.explanation: 'Arrojar luz sobre' (إلى shed light on) هو a key academic و professional collocation بمعنى إلى clarify أو illuminate. Combined مع 'los resultados arrojan' (الـ results shed), هو هو standard لغة في research presentations لـ introducing significant findings ذلك advance understanding.
